# Meghanath Macha

Head of AI & Platform at ZeroToOne.AI. Behavioral foundation models and ML platforms.

- Website: https://mmacha.github.io/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/meghanathmacha/
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=XNzyEd0AAAAJ&hl=en
- Email: meghanath.macha@gmail.com
- Notes (personal short takes): https://mmacha.github.io/notes/

## Now

Leads AI and platform at ZeroToOne. Builds behavioral models from where people go and what they
do online; one model scores 1.7B+ IDs a day across 9,000+ behavioral categories, and the
audiences built on it refresh daily. Built Audience Builder, which turns plain-English audience
requests into checkable definitions. Led technical diligence on ZeroToOne's acquisition of
GroundTruth and WeatherBug; leads bringing the platforms and teams together.

## Previously

At Adobe, led GenStudio's guideline-aware AI systems, delivering semantic knowledge graph
grounding that enabled Adobe's first fully AI-generated marketing campaign and a 60% content
velocity improvement. Earlier, founding ML engineer at ZeroToOne.AI and research scientist at
Adobe Research India.

## Research

Carnegie Mellon Ph.D. in privacy-preserving behavioral modeling. Published in ISR, DMKD, KDD and
Management Science. M.Sc. and B.Sc. in Mathematics and Computing from the
Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.

## Patents

9 granted patents, 15+ filed across behavioral ML, GenAI, and privacy. First-listed inventor on
ZeroToOne's WO2025006073 (modeling user predisposition from location data).

## Notes

Short takes, mostly on building AI systems: https://mmacha.github.io/notes/ (RSS: https://mmacha.github.io/notes/feed.xml)
